bear_assumptions: USD 8.00 normalized forward EPS at 25x as AWS growth slows, retail costs rise, and AI depreciation and financing costs pressure per-share earnings.
base_assumptions: USD 9.00 normalized forward EPS at 30x as AWS and advertising remain strong while AI investment absorbs cash and limits multiple expansion.
bull_assumptions: USD 10.00 normalized forward EPS at 36x as AWS growth and retail margins persist and AI infrastructure converts rapidly into durable revenue and cash flow.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh mark restores required base upside and downside payoff while operating cash conversion improves; downgrade on material AWS deceleration, persistent negative free cash flow, weakening retail margins, rising leverage, dilution, or poor returns on AI infrastructure.
